cohort: The study participants were female kidney transplant recipients, comparing those who conceived after transplantation (cases) with a matched control group of those who did not conceive.
finding: Pregnancy after kidney transplantation can be successful, but is associated with high rates of abortions and preterm deliveries, although graft survival was observed to be higher in pregnant cases compared to non-pregnant controls at 5 and 10 years.
followup_time: Up to 10 years for graft survival, with overall patient follow-up until 2019.
